_comment: Ability effects by ability name (overrides the keyword guess in effects.py). kind: strike (direct damage), dot {damage [min,max], ticks, interval}, heal {amount [min,max]}, buff {stat, bonus, duration}; icon: iconsTK.xml number; cast: cast time in seconds (moving interrupts). Real numbers were server data (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md). stance: true makes a buff a maintained stance (no timer, one stance at a time, shown in the Effects Maintained window; right-click there cancels it). general: true (with an "id") gives every character the ability on the ability book's General page; kinds sprint {speed, duration}, recall (to the bind point), recall_house.

Blood Gift I.description: You use your blood to heal an ally, other than yourself, for 914. Heals for an extra 2% per level of Blood Union.

Constrict I.description: Constricts the movement of your opponent, rooting them in place for 30 seconds. Has a 60% chance to break on hit.

Life Husk I.description: Covers you in a husk of energy, absorbing all incoming damage for 6 seconds. Consumes a vial of blood.

Vitalize I.description: Fills your defensive target's party with life, granting them 23 additional vitality.

Serak's Augmentation I.description: Increases you and your allies Constitution and Physical resistance.

Numb I.description: Numbs your opponent's mind, lowering your hate by 1914.

Strip Enchantment I.description: Strips a minor enchantment from your opponent.

Mental Infusion I.description: Increases you and your allies Intelligence and Wisdom.

Sheltering Rune I.description: Places a rune of flesh on your defensive target that reduces incoming physical damage and arcane damage by 100%. Lasts for 6 seconds.

Regeneration I.description: Increases you and your allies health regeneration.

Sprint.description: Increases movement speed by 25% for 45 seconds

Recall.description: This ability returns you to your bind location.
